promotion_conditions: Every frozen primary and guardrail metric meets its target over the exact frozen universe with complete denominator reconciliation.
Every mandatory gate PASSes with no FAIL/BLOCKED gate at the promotion decision.
The independent evaluator actor differs from the implementation actor and independently recomputes promotion-authoritative evidence.
All frozen artifact registry hashes, the v0.10 parent hash universe, and the final clean-extracted package manifest validate exactly.
Matched empirical execution trials are collected as required shadow evidence, but no shadow metric is used as promotion authority or generalized speedup proof.
Promotion may not exceed PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Machine-readable package-only lifecycle checkpoint exposes exact state, immutable boundary, blockers, validation profile, next legal action, required artifacts, and stop condition.
Next legal action is deterministically derived from state plus blocker transition tokens using frozen lifecycle transition rules, with no answer-key or hidden-chat dependence.
Every explicit dependency has exactly one permitted machine-derived provenance and mechanically derived conflict serialization is included in the effective DAG.
All maximum-work critical paths and deterministic dependency/conflict-safe execution waves are computed exactly.
Maximum useful parallelism preserves source-task coverage and requires context, cache, retry, integration, and verification contracts for every emitted workstream.
Failure reruns only the failed workstream and declared dependents; unrelated successful work is preserved unless explicitly invalidated.
Speculative/preparatory work remains non-authoritative until prerequisites resolve.
Validation profiles and immutable-boundary mechanics are explicit and mechanically checkable with no unclassified/overlap/stale ownership errors under the applicable rules.
Exact 155 parent nodes, 24 active regressions, and 1120 v0.10 manifest hashes remain mandatory guardrails with fail-closed missing-data handling.
All 15 frozen promotion-authoritative metrics preserve reviewed universes/targets; empirical efficiency metrics remain shadow-only and cannot authorize a general speed claim.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.11 implementation or verification fails frozen criteria, preserve all v0.11 evidence and revert executable authority to the promoted v0.10 release without altering v0.10 or earlier bytes.
